mapper.select:
select service_name as serviceName, ROUND(SUM(avg_duration*cnt)/SUM(cnt), 2) as avgDuration, sum(cnt) as totalCount, sum(error_num) as totalError from ${routeInfo.dynamicTableName} where service_name = #{param.serviceName} and span_kind = 2
AND (time >= #{dateParam.startUTC}::TIMESTAMPTZ AND time < #{dateParam.endUTC}::TIMESTAMPTZ)
group by service_name

select time_bucket('${param.strInterval}', time) AT TIME ZONE #{dateParam.timezone} as timeb, ROUND(SUM(avg_duration*cnt)/SUM(cnt), 2) as avgDuration, sum(cnt) as totalCount, sum(error_num) as totalError from ${routeInfo.dynamicTableName} where service_name = #{param.serviceName} and span_kind = 2
and host_name = #{param.hostName}
AND (time >= #{dateParam.startUTC}::TIMESTAMPTZ AND time < #{dateParam.endUTC}::TIMESTAMPTZ)
group by timeb order by timeb

select target_name as targetName, ROUND(SUM(avg_duration*cnt)/SUM(cnt), 2) as avgDuration, ROUND(max(max_duration), 2) as max, ROUND(min(min_duration), 2) as min, sum(cnt) as totalCount, sum(error_num) as totalError, approx_percentile(0.90, rollup(percent_duration)) AS p90, approx_percentile(0.95, rollup(percent_duration)) AS p95, approx_percentile(0.99, rollup(percent_duration)) AS p99 from ${routeInfo.dynamicTableName} where service_name = #{param.serviceName} and span_kind = 2
and host_name = #{param.hostName}
AND (time >= #{dateParam.startUTC}::TIMESTAMPTZ AND time < #{dateParam.endUTC}::TIMESTAMPTZ)
group by target_name

select time_bucket('${param.strInterval}', time) AT TIME ZONE #{dateParam.timezone} as timeb, ROUND(SUM(avg_duration*cnt)/SUM(cnt), 2) as avgDuration, sum(cnt) as totalCount, sum(error_num) as totalError from ${routeInfo.dynamicTableName} where service_name = #{param.serviceName} and span_kind = 2 and target_name = #{param.targetNameHashKey}::uuid
and host_name = #{param.hostName}
AND (time >= #{dateParam.startUTC}::TIMESTAMPTZ AND time < #{dateParam.endUTC}::TIMESTAMPTZ)
group by timeb order by timeb

select time_bucket('${param.strInterval}', time) AT TIME ZONE #{dateParam.timezone} as timeb, action_name as actionName, system_type as systemType, ROUND(SUM(avg_duration*cnt)/SUM(cnt), 2) as avgDuration from ${routeInfo.dynamicTableName} where caller_service_name = #{param.serviceName} and caller_span_kind = 2 and span_kind = 3 and caller_target_name = #{param.targetNameHashKey}::uuid
and host_name = #{param.hostName}
AND (time >= #{dateParam.startUTC}::TIMESTAMPTZ AND time < #{dateParam.endUTC}::TIMESTAMPTZ)
group by action_name, timeb, systemType order by timeb

select time_bucket('${param.strInterval}', time) AT TIME ZONE #{dateParam.timezone} as timeb, target_name as targetName, system_type as systemType, ROUND(SUM(avg_duration*cnt)/SUM(cnt), 2) as avgDuration from ${routeInfo.dynamicTableName} where caller_service_name = #{param.serviceName} and caller_span_kind = 2 and span_kind = 3 and caller_target_name = #{param.targetNameHashKey}::uuid
and host_name = #{param.hostName}
AND (time >= #{dateParam.startUTC}::TIMESTAMPTZ AND time < #{dateParam.endUTC}::TIMESTAMPTZ)
group by target_name, timeb, systemType order by timeb

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalRows, COALESCE(SUM(total_time), 0) as totalDurationSum FROM ( SELECT system_type, action_name, SUM(avg_duration * cnt) as total_time FROM ${routeInfo.dynamicTableName} WHERE caller_service_name = #{param.serviceName} AND caller_span_kind = 2 AND span_kind = 3 AND caller_target_name = #{param.targetNameHashKey}::uuid
AND host_name = #{param.hostName}
AND (time >= #{dateParam.startUTC}::TIMESTAMPTZ AND time < #{dateParam.endUTC}::TIMESTAMPTZ)
GROUP BY system_type, action_name ) AS subquery

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalRows, COALESCE(SUM(total_time), 0) as totalDurationSum FROM ( SELECT system_type, target_name, SUM(avg_duration * cnt) as total_time FROM ${routeInfo.dynamicTableName} WHERE caller_service_name = #{param.serviceName} AND caller_span_kind = 2 AND span_kind = 3 AND caller_target_name = #{param.targetNameHashKey}::uuid
AND host_name = #{param.hostName}
AND (time >= #{dateParam.startUTC}::TIMESTAMPTZ AND time < #{dateParam.endUTC}::TIMESTAMPTZ)
GROUP BY system_type, target_name ) AS subquery

SELECT count(*) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM ${routeInfo.dynamicTableName} WHERE service_name = #{param.serviceName} and span_kind = 2 and target_name = #{param.targetNameHashKey}::uuid
and host_name = #{param.hostName}
AND (time >= #{dateParam.startUTC}::TIMESTAMPTZ AND time < #{dateParam.endUTC}::TIMESTAMPTZ)
GROUP BY caller_service_name, caller_target_name ) as tempTable

SELECT caller_service_name as callerServiceName, SUM ( avg_duration * cnt ) AS totalTime, SUM ( cnt ) AS totalCount , ROUND( SUM ( avg_duration * cnt )/SUM ( cnt ), 2) as avgDuration FROM ${routeInfo.dynamicTableName} WHERE service_name = #{param.serviceName} and span_kind = 2 and target_name = #{param.targetNameHashKey}::uuid
and host_name = #{param.hostName}
AND (time >= #{dateParam.startUTC}::TIMESTAMPTZ AND time < #{dateParam.endUTC}::TIMESTAMPTZ)
GROUP BY caller_service_name order by totalTime desc
